Cave Bat.description: Screechy and hard to hit. Drawn up here by the Altar's leaking mana.

Cave Spider.description: A very scawy spider. Its fangs carry a little Altar residue.

Sewer Spider.description: A grimy spider lurking under the academy. Its bite stings twice.

Pollutabloom.description: A toxic plant that has been feeding on raw mana seeping through the stone.

Ryan Gosling.description: He's just Ken (and very dangerous). Drifted down with the other refugees and never went back.

Limestone Golem.description: A literal wall of pain. It stands in the last doorway before the deep dark.

Ratron 3000.description: A rat piloting a mech suit welded from academy scrap. The cheese is a power source. Do not ask.

phases.message: Armor plating blasts off! RATRON 3000 whirs into OVERCLOCK MODE -- the rat inside is FURIOUS!
